prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Glasarkaden", an upscale glass-roofed shopping arcade in the middle ring of the city, seen from above - a clean, wealthy contrast to the slums: polished white marble floor with thin gold inlay lines fills most of the image (the large walkable area), soft reflections; the glass roof itself is not visible, only a fine grid of roof-beam shadows falls across the marble. Light: bright clean white daylight from above with cool chrome highlights, a few soft pink and cyan hologram glows as accents, warm golden shop-window light.
TOP ROW, a continuous row of elegant shop fronts with short facades: far left a fashion boutique with deep red velvet curtains, mannequins and a gold mirror in the shop window; next to it a pastel cafe with tiers of whipped-cream cakes in the window and a striped awning, its glass door clearly visible; TOP CENTER the most eye-catching spot: a round glass panorama elevator tube with chrome frame and a small brass stand for a lift attendant in front of it, the tube going up out of the image; right of it a noisy amusement arcade with a big glowing pixel-pattern light sign (abstract coloured squares, no letters) and arcade cabinets visible through the open front; top right a sleek white tech showroom with a glass door and a life-size cyan hologram figure shimmering behind the window (a glowing translucent shape, not a real person).
LEFT HALF: a small "glass park" on the marble - four neat rectangular box-hedge beds with tiny trimmed trees, white benches and gravel paths between them, a few bird-seed crumbs (no birds drawn).
CENTER: a large round white marble fountain with three tiers and sparkling water; a small promotional stand with a chrome counter and a floating hologram disc to the lower right of it.
RIGHT SIDE, middle: a delicatessen shop building whose open front with a long glass counter full of cheese, butter, bottles and ice cream faces left into the arcade.
BOTTOM RIGHT CORNER, clearly separated from the shiny arcade by a tall plain concrete wall with NO opening: a grey, slightly dirty service delivery yard (concrete floor, oil stains, yellow hazard stripes): a loading ramp with stacked crates and a pallet jack at the back door of the delicatessen at its top, a big industrial freight elevator with steel sliding doors on its right wall, a metal laundry chute ending in a big canvas laundry cart in its top-left corner, a few bins; at its bottom edge a plain steel service gate (the delivery entrance).
BOTTOM LEFT: a stairway going down into a metro station with a glowing cyan railing and a round metro emblem (no letters).
Small stuff at the edges: potted palms, chrome waste bins, a cleaning robot dock, velvet rope stands, planters.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: BOTTOM edge (south) center - a row of chrome security turnstiles in a low glass barrier (the way to the plaza); TOP center (north) - the glass panorama elevator; BOTTOM edge of the delivery yard - the steel service gate.
Time: day, bright and clean.
